answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 19999 Country: India Title: in my dream isaw my husband and me rolling rotis in jail .in fazir isaw this dream after i heard the azaan. i am crying and thinkg y allah has put us in jail.as we were given so much of love and affection as we had performed haj 1 month back? Question: aassalam alaikum in my dream isaw my husband and me rolling rotis in jail .in fazir isaw this dream after i heard the azaan. i am crying and thinkg y allah has put us in jail.as we were given so much of love and affection as we had performed haj 1 month back? Answer ID: 19999 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 394/320/H=1431) The dream means that you are negligent towards the akhirah (hereafter) and are inclined to the world ( duniya ), this state of affair was warned in the dream that you should leave this state and tend to good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
